desi.title: Indian Wedding Planner Spreadsheet, Mehndi Sangeet Guest List, Desi Wedding Budget, Google Sheets Template
desi.desc:
Planning a mehndi, haldi, sangeet, wedding and reception, each with its own guest list? This Google Sheets planner keeps every function in one place, built for your laptop.

ONE GUEST LIST, EVERY FUNCTION
• One row per family. Mark each function Invited, Yes or No.
• Live counts per function: coming, waiting and how many the venue holds.
• Meal counts per function (veg, non-veg, Jain, vegan, kids).

SEATING
• Pick a function and see who sits at each table.
• Sections such as bride's family, groom's family, friends, elders and VIP. Full tables are flagged.

BUDGET, VENDORS, PAYMENTS
• Budget by category against what is booked and paid.
• Vendors linked to the function they serve. Paid fills in from Payments.
• Every deposit and balance with its due date. Late ones turn red.

CHECKLIST AND EVENT DAYS
• 46 tasks dated back from your wedding day, from booking the pandit to the reception.
• An hour-by-hour plan for each function.
• Rename any function in Events and every tab follows.

WHAT YOU GET
• 1 PDF with your links. Tap Make My Copy and the planner opens in your own Google Drive.
• A filled-in example, so you can see how every tab works before you start.
• 11 tabs: Start, Setup, Dashboard, Events, Checklist, Budget, Vendors, Payments, Guests, Seating, Event Days.
• Any currency: pick yours in Setup, or type your own symbol.
• Three colour themes: Ivory, Blush and Navy.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works in Google Sheets with a free Google account. Best on a laptop; use the free Google Sheets app on your phone for quick updates.
• Not for Excel or Apple Numbers.
• Digital download. Nothing is shipped.
• For personal use. Please don't share or resell the file or its links.
• Designed and built by Kova Studio. AI tools helped during the build.
